description: Chat Completions client on an interactions account: today's core translates the request to the Interactions API; the new core serves it through generateContent with the same key. The upstream's reply carries both an Interactions reply and a generateContent reply, so each core reads its own.

exceptions.reason: An interactions account serves other client formats through generateContent with the same key and the same models, not through the Interactions API as today's core does; under the owner's parity rule the implementation is free, and the Chat client gets the same reply.
